scripts.dev: QUIRKY_REPO_ROOT="$(cd ../.. && pwd)" bun scripts/with-electrobun-devkit.ts hutch electrobun dev
scripts.build: bun scripts/with-electrobun-devkit.ts hutch electrobun prepare && bun scripts/bundle.ts --strict && rm -rf build artifacts && bun scripts/with-electrobun-devkit.ts hutch electrobun build --env=stable && bun scripts/unpack.ts
